pageProps.content: ## Review This is a place I always visit right after arriving at Busan Station. It opens at 10:30, and I always arrive around 10:10, take a walk around Busan Station, and do an "open run" right away. I naturally ordered the `mul-milmyeon` (cold wheat noodles). But this time, since I didn't know when I'd visit Busan again, I ordered a double portion out of regret. After ordering the double portion, I saw `noodle refill` on the menu and wondered what the difference was while drinking the warm broth they provided. The broth here is quite well-seasoned, so it's delicious even on its own. I wish I could take it out and drink it like coffee while walking around. Not long after, they brought the `mul-milmyeon` I ordered. The double portion came in a larger bowl and had more generous portions of noodles and toppings. I thought it might be too much, but once I started eating, I finished it in no time. I thought to myself, 'I still eat pretty well.' I wished there was a franchise near my house. ## Pictures
